"# Walkthrough - Franchise Page Magnifying Glass Upgrades

We have successfully completed all upgrades to the magnifying glass functionality on the Franchise Proposal Page. The application compiles perfectly without SSR issues.

## Changes Made

### 1. Global Page Magnifier Core
*   **Contained Page Wrapper**: Wrapped the page elements (header, main layout, footer) in a `<div id="magnifiable-page">` container inside [FranchisePageClient.tsx](file:///d:/anti-gv/25. 120pie(new)_2/app/franchise/FranchisePageClient.tsx).
*   **Dynamic DOM Mirroring**: Inside the lens container, we render a mirror copy of the page using `dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: pageHtml }}`.
*   **Layout Scaling**: Scaled the mirror container using CSS `transform: scale(1.6)` and positioned it dynamically matching the cursor coordinates, offsetting it for scroll amounts (`window.scrollX` / `window.scrollY`).
*   **SSR Safeguards**: Added a `mounted` state check so client-only DOM details do not render on the server, avoiding Next.js prerendering errors.

### 2. Magnifier Lens Interaction & UI Updates
*   **Enlarged Size**: Increased the lens size to `260px` in diameter, providing a large magnifying view of the layout.
*   **ZOOM Text Removed**: Completely removed the "ZOOM" text from the center of the lens.
*   **Floating Close Button**: Added an `X` close button positioned on the top-right edge of the circular lens (`pointer-events-auto` enabled so it can receive clicks).
*   **Freeze-On-Hover Physics**: Implemented lock-in-place physics. When the mouse moves towards the close button and hovers over it, the lens positioning updates are paused. This freezes the lens in place, allowing the user to click the close button.
*   **Reactivation Trigger**: Added a floating "돋보기 켜기" (Turn on Magnifier) action button at the bottom-left of the screen which appears only when the magnifier is closed.
